diagnostic.demoScanner: Demo scanner: all values are examples.
diagnostic.deprecatedLocation: Claude Code no longer reads {path}; its settings have no effect.
diagnostic.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than {limit} and was not read.
diagnostic.ineffectiveRule: The rule {rule} never matches: Claude Code does not evaluate path rules for {tool}. Use Read(...) or Edit(...) instead.
diagnostic.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON: {error}
diagnostic.legacyAllowedTools: ~/.claude.json lists allowed tools for {project} in an older format; they are not evaluated.
diagnostic.managedOnlySetting: {key} only takes effect in managed settings and is ignored here.
diagnostic.mcpManagedExclusive: managed-mcp.json is present; MCP servers from other levels are not used.
diagnostic.mcpServerDenied: The MCP server '{server}' is blocked by allowedMcpServers or deniedMcpServers and is not evaluated.
diagnostic.mcpServerDisabled: The MCP server '{server}' is disabled and is not evaluated.
diagnostic.mcpServerShadowed: The MCP server '{server}' is defined on several levels; only the definition with the highest priority is evaluated.
diagnostic.mdmProfileDetected: A managed configuration profile exists ({path}); it is not evaluated.
diagnostic.notARegularFile: Not a regular file; it was not read.
diagnostic.policyHelper: Managed settings use a policy helper program; its output is not evaluated.
diagnostic.scopeNotAllowed: {key} = {value} has no effect in project and local settings.
diagnostic.unknownKey: Unknown setting {key}; it was not evaluated.
diagnostic.unparsableRule: The rule {rule} could not be interpreted.
diagnostic.unreadableFile: The file could not be read: {error}
diagnostic.unresolvedPath: The path {path} could not be resolved: {error}
diagnostic.unresolvedVariable: The variable {variable} is not set; the value is shown unexpanded.
finding.additionalDirectory: Additional working directory: Claude Code can read and write here. Reading needs no prompt; writing needs one in the default mode, none in acceptEdits or bypassPermissions.
finding.knownProject: Known project: Claude Code has been used here and can read and write in this directory. Reading needs no prompt; writing needs one in the default mode, none in acceptEdits or bypassPermissions.
finding.mcpFilesystemPath: Directory the filesystem MCP server '{server}' may read and write.
finding.mcpPathArgument: Path argument of the local MCP server '{server}'.
finding.mcpServer: Local MCP server '{server}' ({command}): a separate program with your user rights. Claude Code's permission rules and sandbox do not restrict it.
finding.mode.auto: Permission mode auto: a classifier approves actions without asking.
finding.mode.bypassPermissions: Permission mode bypassPermissions: Claude Code skips all permission prompts.
finding.rule.edit.allow: Allow rule: Claude Code may edit these paths without a prompt.
finding.rule.edit.ask: Ask rule: Claude Code asks before editing these paths.
finding.rule.edit.deny: Deny rule: Claude Code may not edit these paths.
finding.rule.negation: Exception: paths matching this pattern are excluded from the preceding {effect} rules.
finding.rule.read.allow: Allow rule: Claude Code's file tools may read these paths without a prompt.
finding.rule.read.ask: Ask rule: Claude Code asks before reading these paths.
finding.rule.read.deny: Deny rule: Claude Code's file tools may not read these paths. Shell commands that name these paths are blocked as well, other programs are not.
finding.sandbox.allowRead: Sandbox: shell commands may read here again despite a denyRead setting.
finding.sandbox.allowWrite: Sandbox: shell commands may additionally write here.
finding.sandbox.denyRead: Sandbox: shell commands may not read here. Claude Code's Read tool is not affected.
finding.sandbox.denyWrite: Sandbox: shell commands may not write here.
finding.sandboxedShell: Shell commands run in a sandbox: they can read almost the whole computer, but write only to the working directory, the temporary directory and allowed paths.
finding.unsandboxedShell: Shell commands run without a sandbox and can reach everything the user can.
report.title: AI Agent Access Inspector report
warning.containsHome: Grants {path}, which contains the home directory {home}.
warning.dangerousMode: Permission mode {mode} lets Claude Code act without asking.
warning.homeDirectory: Grants the entire home directory with all personal files.
warning.likelyMisanchored: {rule} starts with a single slash and is relative to {anchor}, not absolute. Use two slashes for an absolute path.
warning.managedRulesOnly: Ignored: only permission rules from managed settings apply (allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly).
warning.mcpPendingApproval: Claude Code asks for approval before starting this server; until then it is not active.
warning.overriddenByDeny: Overridden by deny rule {rule}; deny takes precedence.
warning.sandboxDisabled: The sandbox is not enabled, so this setting has no effect.
warning.sandboxExcludedCommand: Commands matching {command} run outside the sandbox.
warning.sandboxUnsupported: There is no sandbox on native Windows; sandbox.enabled has no effect.
warning.shellAllowedWithoutPrompt: The allow rule {rule} lets Claude Code run any shell command without a prompt.
warning.trustNotAccepted: Takes effect only after the project's trust dialog has been accepted.
warning.unsandboxedRetry: Failed commands may be retried outside the sandbox (sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands).
warning.unsandboxedShell: No sandbox is configured; shell commands run with the user's rights.
